# Block `widget`

**Use:** An interactive widget from the widget catalogue; `props` must match that widget's schema.

**Avoid:** Widgets that do not fit the content, or more than one widget per section.

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "widget",
  "type": "order-items",
  "title": "Put the steps in order",
  "props": {
    "prompt": "Order the steps of a query.",
    "items": [
      "Parse",
      "Optimise",
      "Execute"
    ]
  },
  "source": [
    {
      "file": "slides.pdf",
      "page": 4
    }
  ]
}
```

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"widget"` | yes |
| `source` | array of object (1–5) | no |
| `source[].file` | string | yes |
| `source[].page` | integer (≤ 9007199254740991) | yes |
| `type` | string (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`) | yes |
| `title` | string | yes |
| `description` | string | no |
| `props` | object | no |

Every block may carry `source`: 1–5 `{ "file", "page" }` references to the material it came from.
